approved.en: Russian forces continue high-intensity strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, killing dozens at a humanitarian hub, an aid centre and power infrastructure, while Ukrainian drones are now being used to transport wounded troops from the front lines. Russia is also equipping its drones with propaganda messages and cyber threats. In the Oleshky area a cease-fire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces despite ongoing attacks on aid vehicles. Melania Trump is set to host Ukrainian and Russian officials at the White House. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russland utstyrer også dronene sine med propagandabudskap og cybertrusler. I Oleshky-området utnyttes en våpenhvile av russiske tropper for å flytte styrker til tross for pågående angrep på hjelpeskjøretøy. Melania Trump skal ta imot ukrainske og russiske tjenestemenn i Det hvite hus. Dødsfall knyttet til kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel is conducting air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon that have killed a Hezbollah operative, wounded another, and killed a civilian on a motorcycle while wounding a second. Hezbollah is responding with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israeli forces have also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hezbollah svarer med artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å dele ut sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsrammede og fordrivne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israelske styrker har også bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet i Shebaa-dalen. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The United States has sanctioned Indian and Turkish firms accused of helping Iran, while Russia has deepened support for Iran with a missile launcher deal and a Chinese bank is facilitating Iranian and Russian money flows. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den jemenittiske regjeringen anklager Irans IRGC og Hizbollah for å ha sendt 21 eksperter for å støtte houthiene, noe som indikerer økt ekstern involvering. approved.en: Syrian security forces again foiled a Hezbollah-linked bomb plot against the Homs oil refinery while Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defence cooperation deal that includes $403 million in loans. A Lebanese border guard killed a Syrian woman and injured her child, and a landmine blast killed two soldiers in Daraa. Israeli airstrikes continued in southern Syria, and a cleric warned that Iran plans to disrupt oil supplies, while the EU expressed a security scare in Damascus and ISIS activity persisted after the U.S. withdrawal. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

En libanesisk grensevakt drepte en syrisk kvinne og såret hennes barn, og en landmineeksplosjon drepte to soldater i Daraa. Israelske luftangrep fortsatte i sørlige Syria, og en cleric advarte om at Iran planlegger å forstyrre oljeforsyningen, mens EU uttrykte en sikkerhetsbekymring i Damaskus og IS-aktivitet vedvarte etter USAs tilbaketrekning. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Iraqi security forces captured a notorious ISIS gang member in Kirkuk and arrested suspects for usury in Wasit, embezzlement in Mosul and defamation in Najaf, and foiled petroleum-product smuggling in territorial waters. A Jewish heritage museum opened in Baghdad and Iran exempted ships from India and three other nations from Strait of Hormuz transit restrictions. approved.en: Sudan has accused Ethiopia of permitting RSF drones to launch from Ethiopian territory, prompting reciprocal consulate closures and expulsions of diplomats by both sides. The conflict has intensified humanitarian strain, with UN warnings that deadly drone strikes are harming civilians, displaced elderly facing basic-needs shortages, and factories struggling to restart after wartime damage. Bread prices have doubled in Khartoum, deepening a food crisis that threatens further hunger. The war produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Konflikten har forsterket den humanitære belastningen, med FN-advarsler om at dødelige droneangrep skader sivile, eldre på flukt som møter mangel på grunnleggende behov, og fabrikker som sliter med å starte opp igjen etter krigsskade. Brødprisene har doblet seg i Khartoum, og forverrer en matkrise som truer med ytterligere sult. Krigen førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In northern Ethiopia, WHO warns the health system is near collapse as attacks on civilians continue, including an RPG strike near a school in Moyale that killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers and forced Kenya to register over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees. Sudan has accused Ethiopia of allowing RSF drone launches, and both countries have shut each other's consulates. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Etiopia advarer WHO om at helsesystemet er nær kollaps ettersom angrep på sivile fortsetter, inkludert et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale som drepte 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende og tvang Kenya til å registrere over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger. approved.en: Turkey has intensified airstrikes supporting the Somali president, raising civilian casualties, while Uganda is accelerating its troop withdrawal from Somalia and Ethiopia is planning a similar pullout as fighting intensifies. The United States has withdrawn its forces from the strategic Baledogle airfield, and U.S. and an East African nation continue joint airstrikes against an al-Qaeda-linked group. Somali forces are being urged to intensify operations against al-Shabaab near Barawe, and a Somali police officer was killed by an aircraft propeller at Dhusamareb Airport. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA har trukket sine styrker fra den strategiske Baledogle-flyplassen, og USA og en østafrikansk nasjon fortsetter felles luftangrep mot en al-Qaida-tilknyttet gruppe. Somaliske styrker blir oppfordret til å intensivere operasjonene mot al-Shabaab nær Barawe, og en somalisk politimann ble drept av en flypropell på Dhusamareb flyplass. approved.en: Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has seized positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with Congolese government forces. approved.en: Ecuador is enforcing a fourth curfew through Nov. 10 in five coastal provinces as violence escalates, and the military has begun its first land operation against cartels with U.S. assistance, including U.S. Marines seizing a vessel linked to the Los Choneros gang in the eastern Pacific. Heavy rain on Santa Cruz Island in the Galapagos killed a priest when a crucifix fell on him, prompting an archbishop to announce a clergy safety plan. President Daniel Noboa continues to detain opposition leader Luisa González on money-laundering charges. The crisis recorded two battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ecuador håndhever et fjerde portforbud frem til 10. november i fem kystprovinsier ettersom volden eskalerer, og militæret har startet sin første landoperasjon mot karteller med amerikansk bistand, inkludert at amerikanske marines har beslaglagt et fartøy knyttet til gjengen Los Choneros i det østlige Stillehavet. Kraftig regn på Santa Cruz-øya i Galapagos drepte en prest da et kors falt på ham, noe som fikk en erkebiskop til å kunngjøre en sikkerhetsplan for geistlige. President Daniel Noboa fortsetter å holde opposisjonslederen Luisa González i varetekt på anklager om hvitvasking av penger. Krisen registrerte to dødsfall i kamper i 2019, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Venezuelan army bombed an ELN guerrilla camp in Apure, killing at least 19 rebels, while a U.S. drone strike hit an ELN drug depot nearby, causing at least 20 deaths. The United States is negotiating a long-term military presence in Venezuela and Trump has floated a one-day operation to capture Maduro. A U.S. soldier was arrested for betting $400,000 on Maduro's removal and is now in court. Oliver Blanco met a U.S. official in Washington as the negotiations continue. The UCDP counted 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den venezuelanske hæren bombet en ELN-guerrillaleir i Apure, og drepte minst 19 opprørere, mens et amerikansk droneredning traff et ELN-narkotika lager i nærheten, og forårsaket minst 20 dødsfall. USA forhandler om en langsiktig militær tilstedeværelse i Venezuela, og Trump har foreslått en ett-dags operasjon for å fange Maduro. En amerikansk soldat ble arrestert for å ha satset 400 000 $ på Maduros avsettelse og står nå i retten. Oliver Blanco møtte en amerikansk tjenestemann i Washington mens forhandlingene pågår. UCDP talte 2 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
